analysis: The trial executed successfully but did not improve validation performance: host macro HR@10 was 0.5463, versus the previously reported 0.5800 reference (a decrease of 0.0337). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.605, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.585, Electronics 0.455, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.540. Separating clean-context next-item prediction from corrupted-context reconstruction did not support the proposed improvement. The results do not establish why performance declined; changing the views and loss weighting also changes the training signal. Allocated GPU time was 211.72 seconds. No test metrics were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent bidirectional MaskedSASRec per category: 96-dimensional item and positional embeddings, two Transformer blocks with two attention heads, dropout 0.2, and a Linear–GELU–LayerNorm output head. Scores use tied item-embedding dot products plus jointly trained item biases. Each sampled prefix produces a final-mask prediction view and a historical-mask auxiliary view sharing all model parameters. Training equally weights final-position and historical reconstruction sampled-softmax losses with 256 shared uniform negatives, falling back to final loss when auxiliary targets are absent. Uses AdamW, seed 42, up to 200 epochs, patience 25, and validation checkpoint selection. The exported predictor routes all four categories and loads exactly one selected checkpoint per category; it implements no ensemble.
